title: Committee of Supply – Head J (Ministry of Defence)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head J (Ministry of Defence)

sections.label: SAF security deployment for events
sections.summary: The SAF deployed 2,000 personnel and dozens of aircraft, ships and vehicles to provide air, land and sea security domes over Sentosa and parts of Orchard Road.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Because such high-profile events can be attractive targets for terrorists, the SAF mounted a large-scale deployment involving 2,000 personnel, with dozens of aircraft, ships and vehicles, to provide air, land and sea security domes that covered Sentosa and parts of Orchard Road.

sections.label: MINDEF chaired ASEAN defence meetings
sections.summary: In October last year MINDEF chaired the 12th ADMM and the 5th ADMM-Plus, which represents four billion people and 90% of the world's military.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: In October last year, the Ministry of Defence (MINDEF) chaired the 12th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and the 5th 18-member ADMM-Plus, which collectively represents four billion people and accounts for 90% of the world’s military.

sections.label: ADMM adopts air encounter guidelines
sections.summary: Under Singapore's chairmanship the ADMM adopted the ASEAN Guidelines for Air Military Encounters, the world's first such multilateral guidelines, supported by ADMM-Plus countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: This is an important initiative as we prepare to deal with the wave of returning fighters coming back from Iraq and Syria, even as the Islamic State in Iraq and Syria (ISIS) loses ground there.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: I am also glad to report that under our Chairmanship, ADMM adopted the ASEAN Guidelines for Air Military Encounters (GAME), the first such set of multilateral guidelines in the world, with the support of the ADMM-Plus countries.

sections.label: Malaysian vessels entering Singapore waters
sections.summary: Since last November Malaysian government vessels have repeatedly entered Singapore's territorial waters off Tuas, where MPA, PCG and RSN vessels exercised jurisdiction without protest for over two decades.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Since last November, Malaysian government vessels have repeatedly entered Singapore’s territorial waters off Tuas, over which the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA), Police Coast Guard (PCG) and Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN) vessels have exercised jurisdiction and enforcement without any protest or intrusions from Malaysia for more than two decades.

sections.label: Coastline security against external attacks
sections.summary: To deter external attacks, SAF will add optical sensors, coastal radars, unmanned watch towers and, from next year, unmanned surface vessels to patrol Singapore's waters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: The Mumbai attack in 2008 showed us the devastating destruction that can come from the sea, and we are surrounded by seas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: To deter and mitigate external attacks against Singapore, we will beef up security for our entire coastline.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: SAF will add more optical sensors and coastal radars to deter and detect potential threats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: We will build more unmanned watch towers for better coverage of the busy traffic across the Singapore Strait.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: We will also add unmanned surface vessels to patrol our waters, beginning next year.

sections.label: Initial acquisition of four F-35s
sections.summary: The LOR will request an initial acquisition of four F-35s, with an option for eight more if Singapore decides to proceed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Our LOR will request an initial acquisition of four F-35s, with the option of a subsequent eight if we decide to proceed.

sections.label: F-35 unit price
sections.summary: The F-35 unit price ranges from US$90 million to US$115 million per aircraft, comparable to F-15SG prices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The current unit price of the F-35 ranges from US$90 million to US$115 million per aircraft, comparable to what we have paid for our F-15SGs.

sections.label: Invincible-class submarine fleet
sections.summary: The submarines are optimised for warm waters, with a full fleet of four Invincible-class submarines aimed for by 2025.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, we have to optimise them for our warm waters here.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We aim to have a full fleet of four Invincible-class submarines by 2025.

sections.label: Submarine delivery timeline
sections.summary: The first submarine will be delivered around 2025, with full delivery expected by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The first of these will be delivered around 2025, with full delivery expected by 2030.

sections.label: SAF manpower and howitzer
sections.summary: The SAF of 2030 and beyond is designed for a one-third manpower reduction, with the Next-Generation Howitzer needing three men instead of nine.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: In other words, we design the SAF of 2030 and beyond to work with a reduction of manpower supply by a third after 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The Next-Generation Howitzer which I mentioned earlier will only need three men to operate, compared to nine now.

sections.label: SAFTI City buildings
sections.summary: SAFTI City will be progressively built and will have more than 200 wired buildings of varying heights and types when completed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: SAFTI City will be progressively built and will have more than 200 buildings of varying heights and types when completed, all wired up.

sections.label: Singapore-Australia partnership facilities
sections.summary: Under the Singapore-Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, new facilities including Instrumented Combined Arms Air Land Ranges and Urban Operations Live-Firing Facilities are on track to being built.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Under the Singapore-Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, new facilities, such as Instrumented Combined Arms Air Land Ranges and Urban Operations Live-Firing Facilities, are on track to being built.

sections.label: Coordinated land and air training
sections.summary: Completed facilities will allow training large groups of troops for up to 18 weeks annually, a three-fold increase from six to seven weeks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It allows for coordinated strikes between land and air platforms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, when these facilities are completed over the coming years, we will be able to train large groups of troops for up to 18 weeks annually, a significant increase from the current six to seven weeks, or about a three-fold increase.

sections.label: Expanding cyber regulars pool
sections.summary: SAF will expand its cyber regulars through MDES personnel and non-uniformed Defence Cyber Experts, with over 300 hired in the first phase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: To meet these needs, SAF has to expand the pool of regulars for the cyber domain, and they will be Military Domain Experts Scheme (MDES) personnel, as well as the non-uniformed Defence Cyber Experts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We have recently announced that more than 300 will be hired in the first phase.

sections.label: Cyber NSF pioneer batch
sections.summary: The 59-strong pioneer Cyber NSF batch enlisted in late 2018 and is undergoing an eight-month Cyber Specialist Cadet Course, graduating this August.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The 59-strong pioneer batch of the Cyber NSF Scheme enlisted in late 2018 after passing two rounds of rigorous tests.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: They are now undergoing an eight-month-long Cyber Specialist Cadet Course, in partnership with the Singapore Institute of Technology, and will graduate this August.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We expect to take in another 80 to 90 Cyber Specialists this year to beef up our cyber units.

sections.label: NS Hub construction and completion
sections.summary: Construction will begin this year, and NSmen can look forward to their NS Hub by 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Construction will begin this year, and our NSmen can look forward to their NS Hub by 2023.

sections.label: Nominal defence spending growth
sections.summary: Nominal defence spending is expected to grow 3% to 4% each year over the next decade, with this year's Budget a 4.8% increase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: As I have previously committed to this House, we expect our nominal defence spending over the next decade to grow at 3% to 4% each year, to at least keep pace with inflation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: This year's Budget represented a 4.8% increase over last year.

sections.label: Modernised tri-service and cyber SAF
sections.summary: Singapore is on track to build a modernised tri-service SAF, perhaps quadri-service including cyber, to meet real and virtual security challenges.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Singapore is on track to build a modernised tri-service SAF – and perhaps even a quadri-service SAF, including the cyber force – that can meet security challenges both in the real and virtual worlds in the 21st century.

sections.label: SAF safety protocols audited externally
sections.summary: The SAF's safety protocols are audited and assessed by independent professionals from outside SAF.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: The SAF’s safety protocols are audited and assessed by independent professionals from outside SAF.

sections.label: Inspector-General's Office set up
sections.summary: An Inspector-General's Office has been set up to inspect and audit safety practices across SAF.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: As the Minister for Defence has highlighted earlier, an Inspector-General's Office has been set up to inspect and audit the safety practices across SAF.

sections.label: Army full inspection high-risk training
sections.summary: The Army will ensure 100% inspection of all high-risk and field training.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: The Army will also ensure 100% inspection of all high-risk and field training.

sections.label: SafeGuardian app trial Naval Bases
sections.summary: Buddies are informed via mobile safety alerts, and the SafeGuardian app, providing safety checklists, begins trial in Naval Bases from March.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Their buddies nearby will also be informed via safety alerts to their mobile phones. "SafeGuardian" can also provide access to safety checklists on-the-go, compared to the moment where these forms are only available in physical terminals within the camps.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: So, this app will begin its trial in our Naval Bases starting from March this year.

sections.label: Removal of notification requirement
sections.summary: From 1 March today, the notification requirement will be removed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: From 1 March today, we will remove this notification requirement.

sections.label: Faster conversion for suitable NSmen
sections.summary: Suitable NSmen can be deployed to roles like nursing officers after two High-Key In-Camp Training stints and five ORNS years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Previously, they had to complete the full 10-year training cycle before conversion to a role that allows them to utilise their civilian expertise.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Now, if they are found suitable, they can be deployed to roles, such as nursing officers and network communications officers, after completing two High-Key In-Camp Training stints and have served five ORNS years.

sections.label: SkillsFuture@NS initiatives launch
sections.summary: A suite of initiatives called SkillsFuture@NS will be launched this year with public and private sector partners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: A suite of initiatives called "SkillsFuture@NS" will be launched this year with public and private sector partners.

sections.label: NS e-credits course expansion
sections.summary: E-credits are valid up to one year after full-time NS, and their use will extend to about 3,000 selected courses, including SkillsFuture Series courses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: These e-credits are valid up to one year after they complete full-time NS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: We will extend the use of these credits to about 3,000 selected courses, up from the 200, and amongst these courses will be a good number of SkillsFuture Series courses that focus on emerging domains, such as data analytics and cybersecurity.

sections.label: SkillsFuture Advice workshops at career fairs
sections.summary: SkillsFuture Advice workshops will be customised at the quarterly Career and Education Fair held for NSFs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: SkillsFuture Advice workshops will be customised at the quarterly Career and Education Fair held for NSFs.

sections.label: Women selected for camp
sections.summary: One hundred and three women out of 1,000 were selected for the camp.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: One hundred and three women out of 1,000 were selected for the camp.

sections.label: NS Memories digital repository trial
sections.summary: MINDEF and SAF are working on a digital repository called NS Memories, with a trial with an active infantry unit this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: MINDEF and SAF have been exploring ways to allow servicemen to share their personal NS memories and experiences online, while safeguarding security of sensitive information.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: We are now working on a digital repository called "NS Memories" that will give NSmen access to official photographs of themselves and their buddies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: It will allow servicemen to share these photographs on their social media.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: We will conduct a trial with an active infantry unit for "NS Memories" this year.

sections.label: Changing face of terrorism
sections.summary: The face of terrorism has changed from kinetic attacks by Al-Qaeda and Jemaah Islamiah to ISIS' attempts to radicalise and recruit through technology and social media.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: The face of terrorism has changed, from kinetic attacks spearheaded by Al-Qaeda and Jemaah Islamiah in the early 2000s, to the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria's (ISIS’) more insidious attempts to radicalise and recruit followers through the use of technology and social media, to deepen distrust among the communities and sow discontent with the establishment.

sections.label: Singapore Internet and social media use
sections.summary: Singapore has high Internet penetration, and a 2018 study found people spent two hours daily on social media, mainly WhatsApp, YouTube and Facebook.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Singapore has one of the highest levels of Internet penetration in the world, and according to a study done by media company “We Are Social” in 2018, people in Singapore spent an average of two hours daily on social media, with WhatsApp, YouTube and Facebook being the top three most used platforms.

sections.label: Online harms and Digital Defence
sections.summary: People are unaware their posted information can cause harm, as shown by SingHealth hacking and fake news, so Total Defence gained a Digital Defence pillar.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: This example shows how much people take their online lives for granted and are unaware about how the seemingly innocuous information they post about their lives can be used for harm not just for themselves, but for the wider society.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: We know how hackers stole the information of 1.5 million SingHealth patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: We have also seen the spread of fake news on a wide range of matters, for example, plastic rice or Halal pork, to, more insidiously, false accounts of incidents that could inflame xenophobia, communalism and puncture social harmony.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: This is why we have strengthened Total Defence with a new Digital Defence pillar.

sections.label: Recruits' information literacy workshop
sections.summary: With NLB, all recruits in Basic Military Training will attend an information literacy workshop to recognise fake news and online falsehoods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: We will also ensure that our Servicemen are prepared for threats from the digital domain.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: We are working with NLB to have all recruits going through Basic Military Training (BMT) attend an information literacy workshop to equip them to better recognise and deal with fake news and deliberate online falsehoods.

sections.label: Guardians of the City game card
sections.summary: Answering Ms Joan Pereira on reaching youths, the Guardians of the City game card was refreshed to include digital domain threats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Ms Joan Pereira asked about how we are reaching out to our youths.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: We refreshed the “Guardians of the City” game card this year to include threats from the digital domain.

sections.label: CEO impersonation email scam
sections.summary: Digital threats hit close to home when someone impersonated a chief executive officer by email and asked staff to transfer funds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Digital threats hit close to home when someone impersonated their chief executive officer via email and asked the staff for a funds transfer.

sections.label: Community Response Module for personnel
sections.summary: The Community Response Module equips MINDEF and SAF personnel with skills to protect themselves and help others during a terror attack.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: To build emergency preparedness, we have put in place the Community Response Module that equips MINDEF and SAF personnel to be active community responders by teaching them skills to better protect themselves and help those around them in the event of a terror attack.

sections.label: Resilience programme and student game
sections.summary: The Business Psychological Resilience Programme trains company employees in psychological first aid, and five Temasek Polytechnic students developed a Total Defence mobile game prototype.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: For example, the Business Psychological Resilience Programme, part of Temasek Foundation Cares' "Stay Prepared" initiative, trains employees of companies in skills like psychological first aid.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: One example is our five students from Temasek Polytechnic – Benedict, Gabriel, Jed, Martin and Shing Hao.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: They developed a prototype Total Defence mobile application game, named "The Lion City".

sections.label: Total Defence, Bicentennial, fighter variant
sections.summary: Thirty-five years after Total Defence's launch, all communities and faiths must play their part, and MINDEF confirms it is not buying the aircraft carrier version of the Joint Strike Fighter.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Thirty-five years on and after the launch of Total Defence, we must continue to involve all communities and faiths to play their part.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: As we commemorate the Singapore Bicentennial this year, let us strengthen our resolve to safeguard our future of Singapore and Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Is MINDEF at liberty to share whether the variant of the Joint Strike Fighter that is going to be procured, is it the conventional take-off and landing version or the short take-off and the vertical landing version?

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Mr Pritam Singh would be aware that there is an aircraft carrier version, and I can confirm with the Member that we are not buying that one.

sections.label: Army procurement and local industry
sections.summary: The Army develops some indigenous capability locally, and procurement remains price-sensitive and best of class, while a local industry is needed to respond.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: For the Army, some, we have been able to do on our own to develop indigenous capability for local needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, I would say that our procurement is still price-sensitive, best of class, but platforms that meet our needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: And where we can, we also recognise that we must develop a local industry to be able to respond because even developing that capability for private practice requires time and effort.

sections.label: Defence spending doubled
sections.summary: Defence spending doubled from 2003 to 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Defence spending has doubled from 2003 to 2016.

sections.label: Falling cohorts, fewer training areas
sections.summary: Falling cohort sizes mean fewer people entering National Service, and there is a reduction in available areas for training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The first is falling cohort sizes, meaning that we are probably going to have fewer people coming into National Service.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The second is reduction in available areas for training.

sections.label: SAF training area limitations
sections.summary: The question asks how the SAF overcomes training area limitations and ensures sufficient land for facilities and training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: How does SAF overcome its training area limitations and ensure that it continues to have sufficient land to house its facilities and conduct its training?

sections.label: Singapore ASEAN ADMM chairmanship 2018
sections.summary: Singapore assumed chairmanship of ASEAN and ADMM in 2018, and the passage asks what was achieved with the ADMM chairmanship.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: In 2018, Singapore assumed chairmanship of ASEAN and ADMM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: What have we achieved with our Chairmanship of ADMM in 2018?

sections.label: Code for Unplanned Encounters update
sections.summary: The passage asks MINDEF for an update on a Code for Unplanned Encounters for military aircraft and related confidence-building measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: At the Committee of Supply (COS) debate last year, the Minister for Defence spoke about creating a Code for Unplanned Encounters for military aircraft.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: Could MINDEF provide an update on this and any of the confidence-building measures that were introduced to reduce the risk of conflict escalating in the region?

sections.label: Malaysian vessels Tuas working group
sections.summary: The passage states that Dr Vivian Balakrishnan and his Malaysian counterpart agreed on 8 January to set up a working group on de-escalation off Tuas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan, the Minister for Foreign Affairs, a few days back, has set out our Government's position and that of the Malaysian agencies with regard to the intrusions by Malaysian government vessels into Singapore Territorial Waters in Tuas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: We have seen that Dr Vivian Balakrishnan and his counterpart in Malaysia have agreed at their meeting on 8 January this year to set up a working group of their officials that will discuss the de-escalation of the situation in the waters off Tuas and will report within two months.

sections.label: Malaysia vessels withdrawal after collision
sections.summary: The passage states that in February, Malaysia was again asked to withdraw its vessels from Singapore's Territorial Waters off Tuas after a collision.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: In February, we had asked again for Malaysia to withdraw its vessels from Singapore's Territorial Waters off Tuas, after a collision between Greek carrier Pireas and a Malaysian government vessel, Polaris.

sections.label: Declining fertility rate NS numbers
sections.summary: The passage states that by 2030, effects of a steadily declining total fertility rate will be felt with NS numbers dropping by about one-third.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In the runup to 2030, however, the effects of our steadily declining total fertility rate (TFR) will begin to be acutely felt with NS numbers dropping by about one-third from the current numbers.

sections.label: SAF manpower-lean future preparation
sections.summary: The passage asks the Minister to update the House on how the SAF is preparing for a manpower-lean future to defend Singapore from 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can the Minister update the House on how the SAF is preparing itself for a manpower-lean future and outline the SAF's approach over the next few years, so as to ensure that a credible and effective fighting force stands ready to defend Singapore from 2030?

sections.label: F-35 aircraft purchase
sections.summary: MINDEF announced the intention to purchase the F-35, a 5th Generation multirole aircraft for air-to-air, air-to-ground and ISR missions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Chairman, MINDEF recently announced the intention to purchase the F-35, a 5th Generation multirole aircraft, which can perform air-to-air, air-to-ground and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions.

sections.label: Cyber Defence School launch
sections.summary: The launch of the Cyber Defence School provides training across networks and in cyberspace.

sentences.speaker: Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: Recently, the launch of the Cyber Defence School is an excellent move, providing training across the networks and in cyberspace.

sections.label: Digital defence and Cyber NSF
sections.summary: A digital defence pillar was added to Total Defence, and the Cyber Full-time National Servicemen Scheme is a foundational initiative.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Recognising the need for individuals to play their part, a new "digital defence" pillar has been added to Singapore's Total Defence framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Our young digital native Singaporeans are well-placed to protect our nation in cyberspace.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Therefore, the Cyber Full-time National Servicemen (NSF) Scheme is an important foundational initiative.

sections.label: SAF manpower reduction by 2030
sections.summary: SAF will see a projected one-third reduction in manpower supply by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: SAF will see a projected one-third reduction in manpower supply by 2030.

sections.label: Committee to Strengthen NS
sections.summary: The Committee to Strengthen NS, set up in March 2013, recommended WSQ accreditation for skills learnt during full-time NS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The Committee to Strengthen NS (CSNS) was set up in March 2013 to examine how the NS system could be strengthened for the future to better serve Singapore and Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One of its recommendations then was for skills learnt during full-time NS to receive Workforce Skills Qualification (WSQ) accreditation as a means to further enhance the value proposition of NS and facilitate full-time NSmen's (NSFs) transition back to studies or the workplace.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: How is MINDEF working with the relevant agencies to support skills upgrading, so as to further enhance the value proposition of NS today?

sections.label: SAF training enhancements and Inspector-General
sections.summary: The Minister shared training enhancements made after recent training fatalities, and SAF appointed its first Inspector-General.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong (Punggol East)
sentences.text: The Minister also shared some training enhancements which were made in SAF following the recent training fatalities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong (Punggol East)
sentences.text: And just last week, SAF announced that it has appointed its first Inspector-General, who I understand, started in that role on 27 February.

sections.label: Inspector-General safety role
sections.summary: The Chief of Defence Force and MINDEF stated the Inspector-General ensures consistent safety emphasis and has authority to scrutinise and enforce safety processes across the SAF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong (Punggol East)
sentences.text: The role of the Inspector-General was stated by the Chief of Defence Force as being to ensure that command emphasis on safety is consistently applied across all services and units.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong (Punggol East)
sentences.text: MINDEF also stated that the Inspector-General's Office will have full authority to scrutinise and enforce safety processes and practices at all levels of SAF.

sections.label: NS Square renaming
sections.summary: Regulars and NSmen sacrificed their lives building the deterrent force, and the Marina Floating platform will be upgraded and renamed NS Square.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: Regulars and NSmen have sacrificed their lives in building up this strong deterrent force.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: We will be upgrading the Marina Floating platform to be renamed NS Square.

sections.label: Strengthening NS and defence support
sections.summary: After recent training incidents, work remains to strengthen support for NS and defence, and a new Total Defence pillar was introduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Nevertheless, in the wake of the recent training incidents, there is much work to be done to strengthen our people's support for NS and defence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: We have also just introduced a new pillar for Total Defence.

sections.label: Bukit Panjang emergency preparedness guide
sections.summary: The Bukit Panjang Emergency Preparedness Guide was published with the support of the Bukit Panjang Community Emergency and Engagement Committees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: With the support of the Bukit Panjang Community Emergency and Engagement Committees (C2E), the Bukit Panjang Emergency Preparedness Guide was published.

sections.label: Digital defence sixth pillar
sections.summary: The cybersphere is an increasingly viable attack vector, and the speaker strongly supports establishing digital defence as the sixth Total Defence pillar.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: As we step into the digital age, and as our lives become more intertwined with the digital, the cybersphere has become an increasingly viable vector of attack for those who would seek to undermine us.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: I strongly support the establishment of digital defence as the sixth pillar of total defence.

sections.label: MINDEF launches Digital Defence
sections.summary: MINDEF recently launched Digital Defence as a new pillar of Total Defence this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: MINDEF has recently launched Digital Defence as a new pillar of Total Defence this year.

sections.label: Disinformation campaigns in Singapore
sections.summary: Singapore faces challenges, and disinformation campaigns are worrying because they target Singaporeans' hearts and minds and are hard to detect early.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: Today, Singapore faces a range of challenges, one of the most worrying is disinformation campaigns.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: Such campaigns are dangerous because they target the hearts and minds of Singaporeans and are difficult to detect early.

sections.label: Malaysia export restrictions adaptation
sections.summary: In a recent incident of Malaysian eggs, fish and shrimp export restrictions, businesses adapted effectively to food supply disruption, and food security is essential for national security.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: For example, in the recent incident of eggs, fish and shrimp export restrictions from Malaysia, our businesses were able to adapt effectively to the threat of disruption to our food supply.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Food security is an essential requirement for our national security.
